plainTranslation: Their Mars in your 2nd house: they energize your earning and your values; motivation around money, or friction over it. Failure mode: fights about resources, or pressure on your spending. Let them spark your drive to build; keep money talk clean.
policy: Governed by synastry-policy. Descriptive, not deterministic; intensity is never treated as obligation, safety concerns override astrology.
